_provenance.note: LLM reading of the lens token tables; not a measurement

axes.label: 19th century (Victorian era) ↔ mid-20th century (Cold War)
axes.rationale: All three lenses agree: the negative end has ' Victorian', ' Napoleon', ' nineteenth' and year prefixes 181–188, while the positive end has ' Soviet', ' USSR', ' Reagan', ' MTV' and year prefixes 194–198.

axes.label: ordinal/quote-mark suffixes ↔ plural 's' (decade) suffix
axes.rationale: The logit and tuned lenses put 's', 'st', 'nds' and '年代' (decade) on the positive end, suggesting decade plurals such as '1960s'; the negative end has 'th', 'rd', 'teenth', and the Jacobian lens adds quotation marks ('»', '«'), but these tokens are noisy.

axes.label: 's'/'th' suffix continuations ↔ 'rd'/formatting tokens
axes.rationale: The negative end consistently shows 's', 'th', 'est' across lenses, and the positive end has 'rd', '-quarters' and formatting symbols; the remaining tokens look like fragments.
